'''Salamander sticks''' were an item of food. They were served as a side dish to a [[Bantha burger/Legends|bantha burger]] at [[Gep's Grill]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="GG7">''[[Galaxy Guide 7: Mos Eisley]]''</ref>
